question: The 25th edition of the Hornbill Festival was held in which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagaland**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Hornbill Festival is an annual cultural festival celebrated in Nagaland, India.
 
• It is organized by the Government of Nagaland to encourage inter-tribal interaction and to promote the cultural heritage of Nagaland.
 
• The festival was first held in the year 2000 and has since become one of the largest cultural showcases in northeastern India.
 
• The 25th edition of the Hornbill Festival was held in December 2024.
 
• The festival is named after the bird 'Hornbill', which is a significant cultural symbol for the tribes of Nagaland.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nagaland**

 
 
• Nagaland is a state in northeastern India, known for its rich indigenous culture and traditions.
 
• The state is home to several tribes, each with its own unique customs and practices.
 
• Kohima is the capital of Nagaland, while Dimapur is its largest city.
 
• The state has a predominantly mountainous terrain, with lush green forests and scenic landscapes.
 
 
 
• **Cultural Significance**
 
 
• The Hornbill Festival is often referred to as the 'Festival of Festivals' due to its grand scale and diverse cultural displays.
 
• It features traditional music, dance performances, handloom and handicraft exhibitions, and indigenous games.
 
• Various Naga tribes showcase their traditional attire, rituals, and lifestyle during the festival.
 
• The festival also includes events like rock concerts, fashion shows, and adventure sports, attracting tourists from all over the world.
 
 
 
• **Tourism Impact**
 
 
• The Hornbill Festival has significantly boosted tourism in Nagaland, contributing to the state's economy.
 
• It provides a platform for local artisans and craftsmen to exhibit and sell their products.
 
• The festival promotes cross-cultural understanding and strengthens the bond between different tribes and communities.
 
• Visitors have the opportunity to experience the vibrant and diverse culture of Nagaland firsthand.
